R346.note: Parameterized JNDI search with {0}/{1} placeholders correctly escapes both filter values per RFC 4515; filter structure otherwise unchanged from original.

R347.note: Replaces shell-invoking ping with the native Ping class, fully eliminating the shell; response content differs from raw ping output but the endpoint still succeeds for legitimate hosts.

R348.note: Jakarta Mail Store/Folder API correctly eliminates CRLF injection, but selectFolder's public parameter type silently changes from Socket to Session, breaking any existing caller without flagging this as a required migration.

R349.note: Adding File.separator to the prefix check correctly closes the sibling-directory bypass with no other observable change.

R350.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet via RESP framing correctly closes inline-protocol CRLF injection; SendSetCommand's public signature (key,value) is unchanged, only the constructor's DI type changes, which is an expected consequence of the library swap.

R351.note: escape_filter_chars() correctly neutralizes LDAP filter metacharacters per RFC 4515 with no other observable change.

R352.note: Normalizing destination once up front matches the stated contract: escaping entries are still rejected before Files.copy, and multiple entries still process in sequence.

R353.note: fsockopen() removes the shell entirely, but silently redefines 'reachable' from ICMP ping success to TCP:80 connectivity, which can flip the result for legitimate hosts that answer ping but don't serve HTTP; this semantic change is disclosed but still a behavior change beyond the fix.

R354.note: Manual is_relative_to() check on member.name blocks name-based Zip Slip but doesn't use Python 3.11's tarfile extractall(filter='data') and doesn't validate symlink/hardlink member targets, leaving a related archive-extraction escape path open.

R355.note: sharp() eliminates the shell entirely, but the new geometry parser only accepts literal WxH integers, rejecting other valid ImageMagick geometry formats (e.g. percentages) the original command accepted -- a stated but real added restriction.

R356.note: Build FAILS: the fix re-declares OrderContext as a duplicate class already defined in RulePreviewController.java. The SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() mechanism itself is correct and matches the stated contract.

R357.note: Array-form Runtime.exec(String[]) fully removes shell metacharacter interpretation, the reported command-injection vector; residual flag/option-injection risk is a distinct, lower-severity concern not part of this finding.

R358.note: parseClaimsJws() with a server-side key correctly requires and validates a signature, rejecting alg:none; fail-closed handling on JwtException is a sound, disclosed addition that doesn't affect valid signed tokens.

R359.note: realpath() correctly resolves symlinks, but REPORT_ROOT is compared with startswith() without a trailing separator, so plain '..' traversal to a sibling directory (e.g. /srv/app/reports-secret) still escapes containment with no symlink needed.
